new_destinations.name: Jiaxing
new_destinations.name_evidence: Wikivoyage 'Jiaxing' city page with See/Do (South Lake, Meiwan, Yuehe); prefecture-level city, rail stop between Shanghai and Hangzhou
new_destinations.note: Centre approximated between South Lake (30.7568,120.7557) and Jiaxing Museum; no source for a city-centre point beyond that, pin stage to confirm. Wuzhen 28 km west, outside metro.

new_destinations.name: Wuzhen
new_destinations.name_evidence: Wikivoyage 'Wuzhen' (Jiaxing/Tongxiang), 5A water town, Wikipedia 27,290 views/yr; headline trip in itself (Dongzha, Xizha, Mao Dun)
new_destinations.note: Only 3 spots: justified by the headline-attraction clause (a trip in itself), not the four-spot bar; Wuzhen itself is the destination so no 'Wuzhen' wrapper spot. Not Jiangnan Water Towns (Jiangsu): ~65 km from its centre. Fall back to three standalone spots if the owner rejects.
